items.control_name: Enable OCI Cloud Guard at Root Tenancy with Configuration & Threat Detectors
items.description: Cloud Guard must be enabled at the root tenancy target with Configuration Detector and Threat Detector recipes active.
items.current_value: Cloud Guard enabled at Root Target; Oracle-managed detector recipes active
items.recommended_value: Cloud Guard active on Root Tenancy with customized Enterprise detector recipe
items.remediation_notes: Tune detector thresholds to reduce low-severity noise.

items.control_name: Enforce Minimum 365-Day Retention for OCI Audit Service Logs
items.description: The OCI Audit Service retention period must be configured for at least 365 days.
items.current_value: Audit retention currently configured to 90 days

items.control_name: Configure OCI Service Connector Hub to Export Security & Audit Logs to SIEM
items.description: A Service Connector must stream Audit and VCN Flow Logs to Kafka / Object Storage archive for enterprise SIEM ingestion.
items.current_value: Service Connector 'sch-siem-export' streaming Audit logs to Object Storage archive
items.recommended_value: Active Service Connector streaming 100% of audit and security events
items.remediation_notes: Verify Object Storage lifecycle policy archives logs to cold tier after 90 days.

items.control_name: Enable OCI Logging Analytics for Core Workloads
items.description: Workload log groups must be onboarded to OCI Logging Analytics for anomaly detection and machine learning threat correlation.
items.current_value: Logging Analytics enabled for database and compute log groups
items.recommended_value: Onboard all production application log groups
items.remediation_notes: Create saved searches for failed login spikes.
